cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
Characters and Scene: A witty and cute Shiba Inu and a beautiful woman wearing classic ancient costumes. The scene is the edge of a cliff on a mountain peak shrouded in clouds and mist, towering into the clouds, with rolling mountain peaks and a surging sea of clouds in the background.

Plot and Dialogue:

Confrontation and Dodging: The female warrior launches continuous martial arts attacks against the Shiba Inu at the edge of the cliff, punches and kicks generating wind. The Shiba Inu nimbly jumps and dodges, avoiding all attacks.

Pause Warning: The Shiba Inu suddenly stands upright, makes a "stop" gesture with its paws, with a terrified expression, and the subtitle displays: "Stop, stop, stop!". The female warrior stops her movements and looks at it in confusion.

Serious Warning: The Shiba Inu crosses its hands (paws) in front of its chest, its expression becoming serious, and the Shiba Inu dialogue says: "Next I'm going to use my ultimate move".

Mockery and Disdain: Upon hearing this, the female warrior reveals a disdainful and mocking smile on her face, and the dialogue says: "What kind of ultimate move can you have?".

The Unexpected: The Shiba Inu quickly pulls out a black revolver from behind, the movement fluid and sudden.

Panic and Getting Shot: The female warrior turns pale with fright after seeing the gun, opening her arms and retreating backward. The Shiba Inu fires, smoke billows from the muzzle, a red blood dot appears on the chest of the beautiful girl warrior, and the subtitle displays: "Ah!".

Falling off the Cliff: The female warrior loses her balance, falls backward from the edge of the cliff, and plunges into the sea of clouds.

Victory Ending: The Shiba Inu puts away the pistol, stands by the cliff, looking into the distance, with clouds and mist swirling at its feet.

Style: Cinematic camera shots, combining close-ups, medium shots, and long shots, emphasizing the dramatic nature of character expressions and movements. Natural lighting, highlighting the magnificence of the mountain peak and the fluidity of the clouds and mist.

中文提示词:
角色与场景：
一只机智可爱的柴犬和一位身穿经典古装美女。场景是云雾缭绕、高耸入云的山巅悬崖边缘，背景是连绵的山峰和翻腾的云海。

剧情与对白：

对峙与闪避： 女战士在悬崖边向柴犬发起连续的武术攻击，拳脚生风。柴犬灵活地跳跃、躲闪，避开了所有攻击。

暂停警告： 柴犬突然直立，用爪子做出“停止”手势，表情惊恐，字幕显示：“停停停！”。女战士停下动作，疑惑地看着它。

严肃警告： 柴犬双手（爪）交叉在胸前，神情变得严肃，柴犬对白：“接下来我要放大招了”。

嘲讽与轻视： 女战士听后，脸上露出不屑和嘲讽的笑容，对白：“你能有什么大招啊？”。

出人意料： 柴犬迅速从身后掏出一把黑色的左轮手枪，动作流畅而突然。

惊恐与中弹： 女战士看到枪后大惊失色，张开双臂向后退去。柴犬开枪，枪口冒出烟雾，美少女战士胸口出现一个红色的血点，字幕显示：“啊！”。

坠落悬崖： 女战士失去平衡，从悬崖边缘向后倒下，坠入云海。

胜利收场： 柴犬收起手枪，站在悬崖边，眺望远方，云雾在它脚下缭绕。

风格：
电影感的镜头，结合特写、中景和远景，强调角色表情和动作的戏剧性。光线自然，突出山巅的壮观和云雾的流动感。

cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
Oriental Epic Aesthetics. 8K Cinematic Quality. Core Narrative Logic: Suffering -> Breakthrough -> Divinity. Using the extreme lighting contrast between "Blizzard" and "Golden Summit Sunrise" to express the character's momentary sublimation from insignificance to greatness.

[Scene]

Scene A: Halfway up the extremely cold snow mountain, blizzard, extremely low visibility.

Scene B: The summit beyond the clouds, with a boundless golden sea beneath the feet and a scorching sun and sky overhead.

[Character]

Taoist Cultivator. Early stage: Thin clothing, covered in ice and snow, lonely back but spine like iron. Late stage: Radiating a visible golden aura all over, eyes looking down on the world (Looking down on the world), like a deity descending to earth.

[Storyboard]

[00:00-00:05] Shot 1: Solitary Journey · Treading Snow Without Traces

Camera Position: Low Angle Tracking.

Visual: Violent wind and snow almost fill the screen. The walker's feet step deeply into knee-deep snow, every step heavy and firm.

Close-up: Camera moves up to the face, ice and snow cover his eyebrows, but his eyes stare dead at the heights like a falcon, revealing a ruthless determination not to admit defeat.

Atmosphere: Extreme loneliness and oppression, only the sound of wind howling.

[00:05-00:10] Shot 2: Breaking Clouds · Golden Light Bursts

Camera Position: Crane Up & Orbit.

Action: The walker climbs up the last cliff and suddenly stands up straight.

Lighting Change: The camera instantly breaks through the heavy clouds along with his perspective. The wind and snow stop abruptly. A beam of dazzling golden sunlight hits him vertically, dyeing his originally gray body into a sacred gold.

[00:10-00:15] Shot 3: Summit · Resonance of Heaven and Earth

Camera Position: Epic Dolly In.

Action: The walker stands at the peak of the sea of clouds, spreading his arms, robes flapping in the sky wind. He takes a deep breath and makes a soul-shaking declaration to the ten thousand layers of cloud mountains beneath his feet.

[Dialogue/Lip Sync]: "No one supports my soaring ambitions, I tread the snow to the summit alone!"

VFX: As his voice falls, there is no angry explosion, but the ten thousand miles of cloud sea beneath his feet seems to understand the command, surging and retreating layer by layer with him as the center (Clouds Parting), forming a huge vacuum circle, implying the submission of heaven and earth, reaching the ultimate domineering aura.

中文提示词:
东方玄幻史诗美学(Oriental Epic Aesthetics)。8K电影级画质。核心叙事逻辑：苦行(Suffering) -> 破局(Breakthrough) -> 封神(Divinity)。利用“暴风雪”与“金顶日出”的极端光影反差，表现人物从渺小到伟大的瞬间升华。

【场景】

场景A：极寒雪山半山腰，狂风暴雪，能见度极低。

场景B：超越云层的绝顶，脚下是无边金海，头顶是烈日苍穹。

【角色】

修道行者。初期：衣衫单薄，满身冰雪，背影孤独但脊梁如铁。后期：周身散发着肉眼可见的金色气场，眼神睥睨天下(Looking down on the world)，如神明降世。

【分镜脚本】

[00:00-00:05] 镜头1：孤行·踏雪无痕

机位：贴地低角度跟随镜头(Low Angle Tracking)。

画面：狂暴的风雪几乎填满屏幕。行者的一双脚深深踩入齐膝的积雪中，每一步都沉重而坚定。

特写：镜头上移至面部，冰雪覆盖了他的眉毛，但他的眼神如鹰隼般死死盯着高处，透着一股不服输的狠劲。

氛围：极致的孤独与压抑，只有风声呼啸。

[00:05-00:10] 镜头2：破云·金光乍破

机位：升降镜头接环绕(Crane Up & Orbit)。

动作：行者攀上最后一块悬崖，猛然站直身体。

光影突变：镜头随着他的视角瞬间冲破厚重的云层。风雪戛然而止。一束耀眼的金色阳光垂直打在他身上，将他原本灰暗的身躯染成神圣的金色。

[00:10-00:15] 镜头3：登顶·天地共鸣

机位：史诗级正面推进镜头(Epic Dolly In)。

动作：行者站在云海之巅，张开双臂，衣袍在天风中猎猎作响。他深吸一口气，对着脚下的万重云山发出了震撼灵魂的宣告。

【台词/口型】：“无人扶我青云志，我自踏雪至山巅！”

特效：随着他的话音落下，并没有愤怒的爆炸，而是脚下的万里云海仿佛听懂了号令，以他为中心层层向外激荡退散(Clouds Parting)，形成一个巨大的真空圈，寓意天地臣服，霸气到了极致。

Key Action Performance (Staff Form):
04:45 - 04:50 [Eyebrow-Level Staff Array]:
Eighteen copper men line up in formation, the eyebrow-level staffs in their hands instantly charge up, turning into plasma staffs (Plasma Staffs) jetting red lasers from both ends.
Action: Uniform staff chopping and sweeping.
Effects: Every time the staff hits the ground, it shocks out circles of golden energy shockwaves (Shockwaves), causing the chess pieces on the board to levitate.

04:50 - 05:00 [Aerial Stunts]:
The lead monk runs up, stepping on his teammate's shoulders to soar into the air (Qinggong).
[Highlight Moment]: He performs a highly difficult tornado kick (Tornado Kick) in the air.
Visual Spectacle: As he rotates, the leg wind brings out rich black ink particles, drawing a holographic ink dragon (Ink Dragon) in the air, roaring and rushing towards the camera.

Lighting and Visual Atmosphere:
Extreme clash between Ancient Bronze (Ancient Bronze) and Ink Black (Ink Black);
Emphasizing power, speed, and Oriental Zen.

Overall Style: Hardcore Kung Fu × Ink Wash Cyberpunk, combining hardness and softness, magnificent and majestic.

中文提示词:
电影级超精细视频设定，8K 分辨率，动作捕捉与粒子特效。

镜头运动（Bullet Time & 360 Rotation）：

关键动作表现（Staff Form）：
04:45 - 04:50 【齐眉棍阵】：
十八名铜人排成列阵，手中的齐眉棍瞬间充能，变成两头喷射红色激光的等离子长棍（Plasma Staffs）。
动作： 整齐划一的劈棍、扫棍。
特效： 每一次棍棒击打地面，都会震荡出一圈圈金色的能量波纹（Shockwaves），棋盘上的棋子被震得悬浮起来。

04:50 - 05:00 【腾空绝技】：
领舞的武僧助跑，踩着队友的肩膀腾空而起（轻功）。
【高光时刻】： 他在空中做了一个超高难度的旋风踢（Tornado Kick）。
视觉奇观： 随着他的旋转，腿风带出了浓墨重彩的黑色水墨粒子，在空中画出了一条全息墨龙（Ink Dragon），咆哮着冲向镜头。

灯光与视觉氛围：
古铜金（Ancient Bronze）与水墨黑（Ink Black）的极致对撞；
强调力量感、速度感与东方禅意。

整体风格： 硬核功夫 × 水墨赛博，刚柔并济，气吞山河。

cases.title: 奇幻梦境与海洋共舞的唯美交响
cases.imageAlt: 奇幻梦境与海洋共舞的唯美交响
cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
Fantasy Dreamlike Symphony. Elegant and aesthetic, like a ballet of the ocean and music. Visual temperament: Not conquering the sea, but dancing with the sea. The rhythm comes from breathing-like undulating rhymes, not violent impacts. The fantasy comes from glowing seawater, floating water droplets, and aurora-like colors. [Storyboard · 15 Seconds] [00:00-00:03] Overture · Suspended Under the Moon Camera: Slow Rising Push-in Visual: Deep blue moonlit sea surface, moonlight spreading a silver path. The sea surface is as quiet as a mirror, with faint blue bioluminescence pulsing underwater. The conductor, wearing a silver-white sheer dress that dances with the wind, floats barefoot at the end of the moonlight path, long hair floating naturally without wind as if weightless in water. She closes her eyes, holding a transparent crystal baton in one hand, a glowing blue water droplet condensed at the tip. She slowly opens her eyes and gently raises the baton— [00:03-00:07] Movement 1 · Ocean Breathing Camera: Medium Orbital, Slow Rotation Visual: The baton gently falls for the first beat. The sea surface begins to breathe—centered on her, the seawater slowly rises like silk, forming a graceful dome arc, then gently falls, rises again, and falls again, like the chest of a sleeping giant beast breathing. With every undulation, a wave of blue-green bioluminescence flows through the seawater, like light flowing in blood vessels. Her baton-waving movements are elegant like ballet—wrist gently turning, fingertips drawing soft arcs. Every time the baton passes a direction, a streamlined water ridge rises and stretches on the sea surface in that direction, crystal clear and translucent, with aurora-like blue-purple-green gradient colors glowing inside. The tops of the water ridges naturally split into countless tiny water droplets, which do not fall but float in mid-air, glowing faintly like fireflies, gathering more and more. [00:07-00:11] Movement 2 · Seawater Dancing Camera: Crane Orbital, Perspective gradually rising to reveal the full view Visual: The rhythm enters its prime. The conductor's movements are flowing like water, becoming more expansive—her whole body is moving with the melody, as if dancing an aerial solo. The hem of the silver-white dress draws perfect arcs with every turn. The sea surface is completely alive—the seawater is no longer waves, but transforms into giant glowing ribbons of water, rising elegantly from the sea, drawing spiral trajectories in the air, like the arms of a ballet dancer. Dozens of water ribbons rotate and wind around the conductor, forming a huge glowing vortex flower shape, with aurora-like blue-purple-pink gradient fluorescence flowing inside. Countless floating glowing water droplets are like stardust, permeating the entire space; she is like standing in a dream woven from glowing seawater. [00:11-00:15] Finale · Blooming into Silence Camera: Rapid Crane-Up to God's Eye View -> Static Visual: The conductor slowly and elegantly spreads her arms to both sides to the maximum—as if embracing the entire ocean. All the rotating water ribbons expand outward simultaneously, like a huge lotus slowly blooming on the sea surface. From the high-altitude overhead view—the entire sea surface presents a huge aurora lotus with a diameter of several kilometers, composed of glowing seawater ribbons, with layers of petals, and flowing with dark blue, emerald green, and pale purple gradient fluorescence inside. The conductor is suspended in the very center of the stigma, a tiny but glowing white figure. After the lotus fully blooms, all the water ribbons slowly turn into a sky full of glowing fine water mist, like a rain of starlight falling gently back to the sea surface. The sea surface returns to calm, but the underwater bioluminescence is still pulsing gently, like the lingering heartbeat of the ocean after listening to this symphony.

中文提示词:
奇幻梦境交响诗 (Fantasy Dreamlike Symphony)。优雅唯美，如同一场海洋与音乐的芭蕾。视觉气质：不是征服大海，而是与大海共舞。节奏感来自呼吸般的起伏韵律，不是暴力冲击。奇幻感来自发光的海水、飘浮的水珠、极光般的色彩。 【分镜脚本 · 15秒】 [00:00-00:03] 序曲 · 月下悬浮 机位：缓慢上升推进 (Slow Rising Push-in) 画面：深蓝色的月夜海面，月光铺出一条银色光路。海面如镜般安静，水下有幽蓝色生物光隐隐脉动。指挥家身穿一袭随风轻舞的银白色薄纱长裙，赤脚悬浮在月光光路的尽头，长发如丝般在无风中自然飘动——像在水中一样失重。她闭着眼睛，单手持一根透明水晶指挥棒，棒尖凝聚着一滴发光的蓝色水珠。她缓缓睁眼，轻轻举起指挥棒—— [00:03-00:07] 第一乐章 · 海洋呼吸 机位：中景环绕 (Medium Orbital) 缓慢旋转 画面：指挥棒轻柔落下第一拍。海面开始呼吸——以她为中心，海水如丝绸般缓缓隆起，形成一个优美的穹顶弧线，然后温柔地落下，再隆起，再落下，如同熟睡的巨兽的胸膛在呼吸。每一次起伏，海水内部都流淌过一波蓝绿色的生物荧光，像血管中流动的光。 她的挥棒动作优雅如芭蕾——手腕轻转，指尖划出柔美弧线。指挥棒每划过一个方向，那个方向的海面就舒展起一道流线型的水脊，晶莹透亮，内部透着极光般的蓝紫绿渐变色彩。水脊的顶端自然分裂成无数细小的水珠，水珠不落下，而是悬浮在半空中，如同萤火虫般发着微光，越聚越多。 [00:07-00:11] 第二乐章 · 海水起舞 机位：升降环绕 (Crane Orbital) 视角逐渐升高展现全貌 画面：节奏渐入佳境。指挥家的动作行云流水、越来越舒展——她整个身体都在随旋律律动，如同在跳一支空中独舞。银白长裙的裙摆在每一次转身时画出完美的圆弧。 海面完全活了——海水不再是浪，而是化为一条条巨大的发光水之丝带，从海面优雅地升起，在空中划出螺旋形轨迹，如同芭蕾舞者的手臂。数十条水之丝带围绕指挥家旋转缠绕，形成一个巨大的发光旋涡花朵造型，内部流淌着极光般的蓝紫粉渐变荧光。无数悬浮的发光水珠如同星尘，弥漫在整个空间中，她如同站在一个由发光海水编织的梦境之中。 [00:11-00:15] 终曲 · 绽放归寂 机位：极速上升至超级远景俯拍 (Rapid Crane-Up to God's Eye View)→ 静止 画面：指挥家双臂优雅地向两侧缓缓展开至最大——如同拥抱整个海洋。所有旋转的水之丝带同时向外展开，如同一朵巨大的莲花在海面上徐徐绽放。从高空俯拍视角——整个海面呈现出一朵直径数公里的、由发光海水丝带构成的巨大极光莲花，花瓣层层叠叠，内部流淌着幽蓝、翡翠绿、淡紫色的渐变荧光。指挥家悬浮在花蕊正中央，是一个微小但发光的白色身影。 莲花完全绽放后，所有水之丝带缓缓化为漫天发光的细密水雾，如同下了一场星光之雨，轻轻飘落回海面。海面恢复平静，但水下的生物荧光仍在温柔脉动，如同海洋听完这场交响乐后余韵未散的心跳。

cases.prompt: 顶级科幻舞台大秀(Top-tier Sci-Fi Stage Show)。8K超高清，高帧率动态捕捉质感。 核心风格：未来赛博娱乐(Cyber Entertainment)。将机械的精密感与人类肢体的柔韧性完美结合。 动作设计：融合街舞(Hip-hop Dance)、极限跑酷空翻(Acrobatic Somersaults)与中国武术(Chinese Martial Arts)。 光影氛围：全息投影舞台(Holographic Stage)，配合动感频闪的镭射激光(Laser Lights)和舞台冷烟花(Cold Pyrotechnics)。 【场景】 一个巨大的未来体育场中央舞台。地面是发光的LED网格地板。背景是无数挥舞着荧光棒的模糊观众席。 【角色设计（非IP原创机甲）】 “幻影舞者”小队(Phantom Dancer Squad)：由五台流线型、极度敏捷的仿生人形机器人组成。机体采用亮白色陶瓷装甲与黑色碳纤维肌肉束，头部带有律动的音轨LED面罩(Audio EQ LED Visor)。 【分镜脚本】 [00:00-00:05] 镜头1：齐舞爆发·极限空翻 机位：舞台正前方低角度推轨(Low-angle Dolly In)。 动作：五台机器人在动感的镭射灯下进行着极度整齐的机械机械舞(Robot/Popping Dance)。突然，两侧的机器人向后滑步退开，C位（中心）的机器人向前极速助跑，连续完成三个完美的**凌空后空翻(Triple Backflips)**。 视觉奇观：机器人的金属关节在旋转中拉出蓝色的光学残影，每一次落地都精准踩在LED地板的节奏点上，激起一圈发光的数字涟漪。 [00:05-00:10] 镜头2：画风突变·武术阵列 机位：斯坦尼康环绕跟拍(Steadicam Orbit Shot)。 动作：空翻落地瞬间，五台机器人无缝切换动作风格，摆出经典的**少林武术起手式(Shaolin Martial Arts Stance)**。它们动作整齐划一，打出一套刚猛的连环拳和侧踢。 细节：虽然是钢铁之躯，但动作如行云流水（柔韧性极佳）。挥拳的速度在空气中打出白色的气流轨迹，展现出极致的机械动力学美感。 [00:10-00:15] 镜头3：终极定格·烟花谢幕 机位：超广角仰拍接慢动作(Ultra-wide Low-angle to Slow-mo)。 动作：高潮部分。四台机器人同时腾空，在空中做出高难度的**旋风踢(Tornado Kicks)**。C位的机器人在中央凌空劈叉落地，单拳砸向舞台地板——**超级英雄落地姿势(Superhero Landing)**。 氛围爆发：落地的瞬间，舞台后方喷射出十几道数十米高的**金色冷烟花瀑布(Gold Cold Pyrotechnic Fountains)**。所有的灯光瞬间汇聚在它们极具张力的武术定格姿态上，机械面罩上的LED律动达到最高频。

cases.title: 鲤鱼跃龙门极致特效大片
cases.imageAlt: 鲤鱼跃龙门极致特效大片
cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
Epic visual spectacle of Eastern mythology, Hollywood top-tier fluid dynamics effects, 8K ultra-clear, extreme collision of physics and magical light and shadow. Core Idea: From the extreme struggle of a small creature to the dimension-reducing birth of a mythical giant beast. Utilizing extreme slow motion and light/shadow explosions to showcase the epic transformation process of a carp becoming a dragon. Duration 15 seconds. Scene: Extremely treacherous violent grand waterfall, filled with water vapor, above is a gigantic mythical Dragon Gate towering into the clouds, emitting ancient golden light. Storyboard Script. 00 00-00 05 Shot 1 Upstream Struggle and Extreme Resistance. Camera: Extreme close-up follow shot very close to the water surface, with intense shaking and water impact sensation. Visual: Howling wind, the violent waterfall with mud and sand pouring down like a collapsing wall smashes down fiercely. A magical koi carp covered in tiny scars but with scales flashing dazzling golden light is swimming upstream desperately in the extremely violent current. Tens of millions of tons of real water splashes smash onto its body, and every crazy tail flick of the koi bursts out huge water waves full of power. 00 05-00 10 Shot 2 Ultimate Leap and Frozen Time. Camera: Rapid pull-back side low-angle shot, instantly switching to 1000fps ultra-slow motion close-up. Visual: The koi exerts its last bit of strength, its tail fiercely smashes the water surface, and its whole body breaks through the thick water curtain like a golden cannonball, leaping into the air. Time seems completely frozen at this moment. The koi hovers in mid-air with its body stretched, flying relentlessly towards the huge Dragon Gate high above that emits divine golden light, and every drop of water shaken off its body refracts colorful halos under the divine light. 00 10-00 15 Shot 3 Crossing the Divine Gate and the Dragon's Arrival. Camera: Epic grand panoramic low-angle shot, combined with explosive vertical lens ascension. Visual: At the absolute instant the koi's body touches the Dragon Gate light curtain, it erupts with blinding golden light like a supernova explosion, instantly swallowing the entire screen. In the dazzling light spots, the koi's tiny body rapidly reassembles and expands, instantly transforming into a majestic Eastern Divine Dragon with a body covering the sky and pure gold five claws. The giant dragon lets out a terrifying roar that shatters the dark clouds in the sky, bringing up extremely violent golden lightning and airflow, rushing straight into the vast sky. The frame freezes shockingly in the ultimate sense of oppression of a deity descending.

cases.title: 硅谷片头风微缩城市的极速崛起
cases.imageAlt: 硅谷片头风微缩城市的极速崛起
cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
HBO Silicon Valley intro style quality, isometric view, tilt-shift photography effect, miniature model sandbox, 3D high-speed time-lapse animation, 8K ultra-clear, clean tech aesthetic. Core Creative: Replicating the rapid construction and iteration of a miniature city, showcasing the high-speed development of the technology industry in the AI era, the prosperity of urban intelligent upgrades, and the growth of new forces. Duration: 15 seconds. Scene: An isometric miniature tech city sandbox based on the Bay Area, filled with construction machinery, smart facilities, digital networks, and rapidly iterating modern buildings. Storyboard Script. 00:00-00:04 Shot 1: Smart Campus Rapid Construction. Camera Position: Isometric high-angle overhead view, smooth pan right. Visual: High-speed time-lapse rhythm. In the miniature city, a large smart computing campus rapidly grows and takes shape, with the campus expanding in an orderly manner. Numerous miniature drones and smart data vehicles shuttle orderly on the roads, leaving soft blue light trails. 00:04-00:08 Shot 2: Digital Industry Iteration and Upgrade. Camera Position: Camera smoothly pushes in, focusing on the core commercial district of the city. Visual: Old-style blocks are orderly renovated, new-generation digital tech buildings are quickly completed, and the tops of the buildings display fluid light and shadow visuals. Construction machinery efficiently builds computing modules, and the city appearance undergoes rapid modernization upgrades. 00:08-00:12 Shot 3: Rising of Cutting-edge Tech Highlands. Camera Position: Camera follows the perspective of a holographic drone, quickly panning to the city's core highland. Visual: Amidst the rapid development of the city, a skyscraper with a futuristic fluid design and emitting soft neon glow is rapidly built. The building's facade displays a clear "Seedance 2.0" light and shadow logo. The building quickly extends digital light bridges, connecting surrounding smart nodes to form an efficient digital cluster. 00:12-00:15 Shot 4: Tech City Prosperity Panorama. Camera Position: Global wide-angle uniform pull-back. Visual: Lexin Technology and major smart tech parks together constitute a dense and prosperous future tech city. The sky is filled with orderly low-altitude traffic routes and digital light and shadow advertisements. The entire miniature sandbox, under the interweaving of sunset afterglow and neon light and shadow, presents a prosperous and orderly panoramic view of the tech city, freezing perfectly.

cases.title: 乡村惊现奇异飞马的手机实录
cases.imageAlt: 乡村惊现奇异飞马的手机实录
cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
Creative pseudo-documentary short film style. Mobile phone vertical screen 9:16 shooting, cheap Android phone quality, realistic, non-professional shooting, one shot to the end zero editing handheld unstable, 10 seconds. Image quality requirements: low resolution high noise over-sharpened color temperature yellowish-green, severe compression pixelated during motion, focus hesitating jumping back and forth between subject and background, handheld shaking is irregular trembling of real human hand shaking. Scene: Ordinary Chinese rural dirt road, road surface is dirt and gravel, grassland and crop fields on both sides, overcast day flat light. Screen start: Phone shooting from the side, a brown and white spotted horse is walking slowly on the dirt road, no one leading no one riding walking by itself. Two huge wings grow on both sides of the horse's back, wings folded against the body sides rising and falling slightly with walking. Feathers grayish-white with dirty yellowish tinge, stained with mud and dust, texture like rough enlarged version of rural goose wings, messy tip feathers with some broken, looks like this horse has always lived in the village. Horse hooves stepping on the dirt road have a sense of weight, tail occasionally flicks, wings occasionally slightly open and close like stretching muscles, lowered head to bite a mouthful of grass by the roadside then continued walking. Phone shooter follows walking, picture unstable, occasionally tripping over feet picture shakes violently. Human dialogue (dialect colloquial, non-broadcasting tone): Shooter: "Hey look look—its wings moved—" Person nearby: "Are these wings real or fake?" Shooter: "Look it moves by itself must be real—" Distant woman: "Don't get too close—" Child shouting in distance: "Mom that horse has wings!" Shooter: "I'm recording I'm recording—" Last three seconds: Horse suddenly stops, ears pricked up, wings suddenly fully unfolded huge wingspan, vigorously flapped down once kicking up dust and broken grass, front hooves off the ground leaping into the air flying upward. Picture shakes violently focus lost, only a blurred winged shadow can be seen rapidly rising and becoming smaller. Everyone exclaims at the same time, child screams, distant dog barks. Video ends abruptly amidst exclamations. Audio: Phone microphone recording, high wind noise, human voice overloaded when close, distant sounds blurred, obvious background noise. No background music throughout.

中文提示词:
创意伪纪实短片风格。手机竖屏9:16拍摄，廉价安卓手机画质，写实，非专业拍摄，一镜到底零剪辑手持不稳，10秒。 画质要求：低分辨率高噪点过度锐化色温偏黄绿，压缩严重运动时像素化，对焦犹豫在主体和背景之间来回跳，手持抖动是真人手抖的不规则颤动。 场景：普通中国农村土路，路面是土和碎石，两侧草地和庄稼地，阴天光线平淡。 画面开始：手机从侧面拍，一匹棕白花色的马正在土路上慢悠悠地走，没人牵没人骑自己溜达。马的背部两侧各长着一只巨大的翅膀，翅膀收拢贴在身体两侧随走路轻微起伏。羽毛灰白色泛着脏兮兮的土黄，沾了泥灰，像农村大鹅翅膀放大版的粗糙质感，尖端羽毛凌乱有几根断了，看起来这匹马就一直生活在村里。 马蹄子踩在土路上有重量感，尾巴偶尔甩一下，翅膀偶尔微微张开又合上像在活动筋骨，路边低头啃了一口草又继续走。 手机拍摄者跟着走，画面不稳，偶尔脚步绊一下画面猛晃。 人声对话（方言口语，非播音腔）： 拍摄者："哎你看你看——它翅膀动了——" 旁边人："这翅膀是真的假的啊？" 拍摄者："你看它自己会动肯定是真的——" 远处女人："别太近了啊——" 小孩远处喊："妈妈那个马有翅膀！" 拍摄者："我在录了我在录了——" 最后三秒：马突然停下，耳朵竖起，翅膀猛地完全展开翼展巨大，用力向下扇了一下掀起灰尘和碎草，前蹄离地腾空而起向上飞去。画面剧烈晃动对焦丢失，只能模糊看到一个带翅膀的影子快速升高变小。所有人同时惊呼，小孩尖叫，远处狗吠。视频在惊呼声中突然结束。 音频：手机麦克风收音，风噪大，人声近时过载，远处声音模糊，底噪明显。全程无配乐。

cases.title: 一分钟极速美妆变身挑战
cases.imageAlt: 一分钟极速美妆变身挑战
cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
Video Theme: Fast-Paced One Minute Makeup Challenge
Core Idea: Create a vertical beauty short video with a duration of approximately 10 seconds. The core concept of the video is "One Minute Makeup Challenge," with a countdown timer starting from 01:00 displayed on the screen. The video needs to clearly show every key step from bare face to finished makeup, accompanied by text labels, but the overall pace is faster than the original video, with almost no pause between transitions, creating a smooth and efficient "accelerated" feel.
Visual Style & Parameters:
• Shot: Fixed camera Medium close-up, vertical format (9:16).
• Lighting: Bright, clean studio lighting.
• Background: Simple solid color gradient background.
• Pacing: Brisk, compact. The transition of each makeup step is rapid but clearly distinguishable, retaining the "rhythm" of the original video.
• Graphics:
• A white digital countdown timer starting from 01:00, counting down uniformly within the total duration of the video to 00:00.
• When each makeup step appears, concise bilingual Chinese and English text labels will be superimposed on the screen (e.g., "Foundation and Concealer / Foundation and Concealer").
Keyframes & Flow Description: The video flow remains consistent with the original video, but the duration of each step is shortened accordingly:
1. Opening: Bare face appearance, the screen displays the title "One Minute Makeup" and a timer counting down from 01:00.
2. Base Makeup: "Foundation and Concealer" effect appears instantly, skin becomes flawless.
3. Contouring: Immediately afterwards, "Highlight", "Blend", and "Loose Powder" effects appear in sequence, making facial contours three-dimensional.
4. Eye Makeup: "Eyeshadow", "Eyeliner and Mascara" effects stack quickly, completing the eye makeup.
5. Cheek & Lip: "Blush" and "Lipstick/Lip Gloss" effects appear, enhancing complexion.
6. Hairstyle & Accessories: The text "You forgot to curl hair" appears, and the hair instantly changes to fluffy long curly hair. Immediately afterwards, gorgeous jewelry accessories are instantly worn.
7. Ending Freeze: When the timer reaches zero, look confidently at the lens with a complete gorgeous look as the ending.

cases.title: 金山寺暴雨死斗法海斗白蛇
cases.imageAlt: 金山寺暴雨死斗法海斗白蛇
cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
Hollywood-level Oriental fantasy action epic. 8K IMAX movie quality, combination of high-speed photography and slow motion. Emphasizing martial arts and magic duels in human form, and the oppressive sense of massive creatures after transformation. The visual tone is a deathmatch in the torrential rain between the golden unyielding power of Buddhism and the cyan-white soft power of the demon race.

Scene
The square in front of the main hall of Jinshan Temple, mostly submerged by torrential floods. Torrential rain pouring down, thunder and lightning interweaving, ancient buildings teetering in the wind and rain.

Characters
1. Fahai: Expression of a wrathful Vajra, muscles knotted, holding a demon-subduing staff, body burning with materialized golden Buddhist flames.
2. Bai Suzhen (Human form): White clothes soaked by rain, extremely fast movement, wielding two cyan-light swords gathered with water essence.
3. Bai Suzhen (Demon form): An ancient white snake as massive as a mountain, scales hard as jade, emitting cold air.

Storyboard Script

00:00-00:05 Shot 1: Close-quarters deathmatch · Martial arts vs. magic duel
Camera: Handheld tracking shot combined with fast editing.
Action: The two engage in a suffocating close-quarters fast fight in the flood. Fahai's staff swings wide, each strike bringing golden explosive air waves that blast apart the surrounding floodwaters. Bai Suzhen moves like lightning, her twin swords unleashing dense cyan water blades to parry and counterattack.
VFX: Golden Buddhist light and cyan demonic energy collide crazily at extremely close range, weapons clashing to burst out dense energy sparks and shockwaves, shattering the surrounding stone railings.

00:05-00:09 Shot 2: Setback and transformation · Giant beast descends
Camera: Rapid pull-back followed by a low-angle push-in.
Action: Fahai strikes Bai Suzhen back hundreds of meters with a heavy staff blow. Bai Suzhen stabilizes her figure in the air and lets out a shrill long roar towards the sky.
VFX: A blinding white light reaching the sky erupts. Inside the light, her figure rapidly expands, instantly transforming into a sky-blocking giant white snake coiling above Jinshan Temple. The huge snake head looks down at the tiny Fahai, maximizing the sense of oppression.

00:09-00:12 Shot 3: Indestructible Vajra · Unleashing the Golden Bell Shield
Camera: Medium shot impact lens.
Action: Facing the giant beast, Fahai plunges his staff into the ground, forms hand seals rapidly with both hands, and roars angrily.
VFX: An incredibly huge, semi-transparent solid golden bell shield appears out of thin air, completely covering his whole body. The surface of the golden bell flows with countless glowing Sanskrit scriptures, emitting an indestructible aura.

00:12-00:15 Shot 4: Brute force breaking defense · Ultimate shattering
Camera: Highly tense slow-motion close-up explosion shot.
Action: The thick tail of the giant white snake carries immense force, sweeping horizontally against the golden bell shield like a battering ram.
VFX: At the moment of contact, energy compression creates blinding light spots. Immediately afterwards, accompanied by a world-shattering bang, the seemingly invincible golden bell shield is covered in cracks, finally exploding completely into billions of golden energy fragments and light dust splashing in the torrential rain. Fahai is sent flying, vomiting blood.

中文提示词:
好莱坞级东方魔幻动作史诗。8K IMAX电影画质，高速摄影与慢镜头结合。强调人形态下的武术与法术对轰，以及变身后的巨物压迫感。视觉基调是金色的佛门至刚之力与青白色的妖族柔劲在暴雨中的死斗。

场景
被滔天洪水淹没大半的金山寺主殿前广场。暴雨如注，雷电交加，古建筑在风雨中摇摇欲坠。

角色
1. 法海：表情怒目金刚，肌肉虬结，手持降妖禅杖，周身燃烧着实质化的金色佛光烈焰。
2. 白素贞（人形态）：白衣被雨水打湿，身法极快，双手挥舞两把汇聚水流精气的青光宝剑。
3. 白素贞（妖形态）：体型如山岳般庞大的上古白蛇，鳞片坚硬如玉，散发寒气。

分镜脚本

00:00-00:05 镜头1：近身死斗·武术与法术对轰
机位：手持跟随摄影配合快速剪辑。
动作：两人在洪水中展开令人窒息的近身快打。法海的禅杖大开大合，每一击都带起金色的爆炸气浪，将周围的洪水炸开。白素贞身形如电，双剑挥出密集的青色水刃格挡反击。
特效：金色的佛光与青色的妖气在极近距离内疯狂对撞，兵器相交爆发出密集的能量火花和冲击波，震碎了周围的石栏杆。

00:05-00:09 镜头2：受挫变身·巨兽降临
机位：极速拉远接仰拍推镜。
动作：法海一记重杖将白素贞击退数百米。白素贞在空中稳住身形，仰天凄厉长啸。
特效：一道刺眼的通天白光爆发。她在光芒中身形极速膨胀，瞬间化作一头遮天蔽日的白色巨蛇盘踞在金山寺上空。巨大的蛇头俯瞰着渺小的法海，压迫感拉满。

00:09-00:12 镜头3：金刚不坏·祭出金钟罩
机位：中景冲击镜头。

The girl sits upright on a towering giant pink-white gradient celestial flower stamen throne, the stamens blooming layer by layer emitting a divine soft glow; overall pink-white + purple cool tone, dreamy and ethereal.

cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
characters: A young woman
cinematic_style: A gorgeous, vivid photorealist style using a SnorriCam rig and cinema lenses for absolute center-locked focus. Transitions rely on seamless backgrounds that physically melt and snap into new environments, seamlessly synced to a spatial audio soundscape.
description: The sole focus of the video. She maintains a completely center-locked facial position throughout the entire cycle, staring dead ahead regardless of the environment warping and evolving around her.
video_prompt:
  subject:
    description: A young woman viewed entirely from the front, positioned dead center in the frame.
    action: She experiences a continuous, fluid cycle of getting ready, partying, wandering, and crashing. Her environment continuously melts and shifts around her while she maintains direct eye contact and a center-locked facial position.
    dialogue: "Here we go."
  visual_dynamics:
    transformation_speed: The environment, lighting, and her attire fluidly bleed into one another. Transitions are not cuts but seamless, continuous morphs driven by the rhythm of a heavy, pulsating club beat, morphing the boundaries between locations.
    consistency: Her face remains absolutely locked in the center of the frame, facing forward. The end of the video matches the exact starting frame to create a perfect, infinite loop.
  scene_sequences:
    - Lying flat on her back on a messy bed, staring blankly straight up at the camera, illuminated by dim morning sunlight.
    - The messy bedsheets smoothly morph into a bright vanity mirror. She is now sitting perfectly upright, applying bold lipstick while looking dead ahead.
    - The mirror reflection expands and engulfs the room, melting into the center of a crowded, neon-lit nightclub. The background becomes a fluid blur of moving bodies.
    - The nightclub crowd sweeps past her, pulling the environment into an ultraviolet glow. She tips her head back slightly to down a glowing neon shot glass, seamlessly materializing in the middle of a massive EDM festival.
    - As she whispers "Here we go," the festival lasers liquefy and reform into aggressive strobe lights. She is now dancing wildly backstage with a club DJ, her hair messy and sweat glistening on her forehead.
    - The aggressive strobe lights fluidly shift into the flashing glow of advertising billboards in the dark, revealing her standing outside on a city street.
    - The harsh city darkness fades into the fluorescent glow of a famous fast-food restaurant. She is sitting in a booth eating french fries, dressed exactly as she was outside.
    - The restaurant walls warp and contract into a sterile, brightly lit bathroom with a flickering neon light. She looks tired and confused as she looks into the mirror, breathing heavily, her attire unchanged.
    - The sterile bathroom tiles soften and morph back with fluid motion into the messy bedsheets from the beginning. She is lying flat on her back, eyes snapping open to stare blankly straight up at the camera, identical to the first frame.
  art_styles:
    - Highly dynamic lighting fluidly shifting from natural morning to neon club to harsh city strobes
    - Perfect facial-locked stabilization (SnorriCam effect)
  audio_context: A muffled ticking clock that organically builds into a deafening techno bass drop, melting into a chaotic city hum, and ending with a sharp gasp for air.

characters: 一位年轻女子

description: 视频的唯一焦点。她在整个循环中保持完全中心锁定的面部位置，无论周围环境如何扭曲和演变，都死死地盯着前方。
video_prompt:
  subject:
    description: 一位完全从正面观看的年轻女子，位于画面的正中心。
    action: 她经历着一个连续、流畅的循环，包括准备、聚会、游荡和崩溃。她的环境在她周围不断融化和变化，而她保持着直接的眼神交流和中心锁定的面部位置。
    dialogue: "我们开始吧。"
  visual_dynamics:
    transformation_speed: 环境、灯光和她的服装流畅地相互渗透。转场不是剪辑，而是由沉重、脉动的俱乐部节拍节奏驱动的无缝、连续变形，改变了地点之间的界限。
    consistency: 她的脸保持绝对锁定在画面中心，朝向前方。视频的结尾与起始帧完全匹配，创造一个完美的、无限的循环。
  scene_sequences:
    - 仰面躺在一张凌乱的床上，茫然地直视上方的相机，被昏暗的晨光照亮。
    - 凌乱的床单平滑地变形为明亮的梳妆镜。她现在坐得笔直，一边涂着大胆的口红，一边直视前方。
    - 镜子反射扩大并吞没房间，融化成一个拥挤、霓虹灯闪烁的夜总会中心。背景变成了移动身体的流动模糊。
    - 夜总会的人群从她身边掠过，将环境拉入紫外线光辉中。她微微仰头喝下一杯发光的霓虹子弹杯，无缝地显现在一个大型 EDM 音乐节的中央。
    - 当她低语 "我们开始吧" 时，音乐节的激光液化并重组为侵略性的频闪灯。她现在正和一位俱乐部 DJ 在后台狂野地跳舞，头发凌乱，额头上闪烁着汗水。
    - 侵略性的频闪灯流畅地转变为黑暗中广告牌闪烁的光芒，显示她站在城市街道的外面。
    - 严酷的城市黑暗淡入一家著名快餐店的荧光光辉。她坐在卡座里吃薯条，穿着和在外面一模一样的衣服。
    - 餐厅墙壁扭曲并收缩成一个无菌、明亮的浴室，闪烁着霓虹灯。她看着镜子，看起来疲惫而困惑，呼吸沉重，她的服装没有改变。
    - 无菌的浴室瓷砖软化并随着流畅的动作变形回开始时凌乱的床单。她仰面躺着，眼睛猛地睁开，茫然地直视上方的相机，与第一帧完全相同。
  art_styles:
    - 高度动态的灯光从自然的晨光流畅地转变为霓虹俱乐部灯光，再到严酷的城市频闪灯
    - 完美的面部锁定稳定（SnorriCam 效果）
  audio_context: 一个沉闷的滴答作响的时钟，逐渐有机地构建成震耳欲聋的科技舞曲贝斯重音，融化成混乱的城市嗡嗡声，并以一声尖锐的喘息声结束。

cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
[
  Hook
] 0–3s: Against a blue-sky background,
a white-winged angel slowly draws a red longbow. The arrowhead points toward the camera. The camera rapidly pushes in to her cold gaze and red lips. Line 1 (Angel,
cold judgment): “Those who loved but were not loved in return — today,
I pass judgment.” SFX: Bowstring tightening; background sound suddenly cuts out. [
  Conflict Development
] 4–9s: The camera circles around her,
revealing her ornate patterned clothing and massive wings. Feathers drift in the wind. A delicate floral crown atop her head sways gently. The red arrow fletching glints in the sunlight. Line 2 (Angel,
mocking whisper): “Did you think the god of love only spreads affection? Wrong… I also rule over betrayal and punishment.” SFX: Wings beating in the wind; mysterious choir-like background music rises. [
  Conflict Escalation
] 10–12s: She slowly pulls the bow to its full draw. Red ribbons flutter in the air. Close-up on her determined expression as golden light flickers at the arrow tip. Line 3 (Angel,
commanding declaration): “Those who betray true love shall be pierced by this arrow!” SFX: Bowstring trembling at maximum tension; background music surges. [
  Suspense Ending
] 13–15s: She releases the string. The red arrow streaks across the sky like a beam of light. The frame freezes on her turning away,
spreading her wings to fly off. Feathers scatter in the air. In the distant sky,
a blood-red crack appears. Line 4 (Distant scream,
anguished): “No… why…” SFX: Arrow slicing through the air,
followed by sudden silence — only the soft rustling of falling feathers remains. Overall style: High-saturation dreamy color palette,
strong contrast of gold,
red,
and white. Cinematic fantasy texture,
soft natural lighting,
rich feather particle effects. Restrictions: No subtitles,
logos,
or watermarks in any scene.

【钩子】
0–3 秒：蓝天背景下，
一位白翼天使缓缓拉开一把红色长弓。箭头对准镜头。
镜头快速推进至她冰冷的目光与红唇。
台词 1（天使，冰冷审判）：
“那些爱过却未被回应的人 —— 今日，我降下审判。”
音效：弓弦绷紧；背景音骤然消失。
【冲突展开】
4–9 秒：镜头环绕她旋转，
展现她带有华丽纹样的服饰与巨大羽翼。羽毛随风飘落。
头顶精致的花冠轻轻晃动。红色箭羽在阳光下闪烁。
台词 2（天使，嘲讽低语）：
“你以为爱神只散播情意？错了…… 我亦执掌背叛与惩戒。”
音效：羽翼振风；神秘的合唱式背景音乐渐起。
【冲突升级】
10–12 秒：她缓缓将弓拉满。
红色丝带在空中飞舞。特写她坚定的神情，箭尖闪烁金光。
台词 3（天使，威严宣告）：
“背叛真爱之人，必为此箭所穿！”
音效：弓弦在满张力下震颤；背景音乐激昂攀升。
【悬念结尾】
13–15 秒：她松开弓弦。
红色箭矢如光束划破天际。画面定格在她转身、展翅离去的瞬间。
羽毛四散纷飞。遥远的天空中，出现一道血红裂痕。
台词 4（远方惨叫，痛苦）：
“不…… 为什么……”
音效：箭矢破空声，随后骤然寂静 —— 仅余羽毛飘落的轻响。
整体风格：高饱和度梦幻色调，金、红、白强烈对比。
电影级奇幻质感，柔和自然光影，丰富羽毛粒子特效。
限制：所有场景无字幕、无标识、无水印。

A high-speed jet-skimmer (needle hull, brushed alloy, teal pulse lights) rockets along a canal corridor like a blade, throwing a razor-thin rooster tail that peels into spirals while steam squalls rise where warm vents meet rain-chilled water. The camera maintains a rapid orbit while dropping altitude, continuously shifting distance in one fluid move: wide orbit for scale, then a violent swoop closer, then back out, each pass revealing a different angle as the skimmer rides centimeters above the surface, hydro-foils kissing the water, spray turning to mist in the humid air.On a tight pass, snap into a steep top-down lock for a beat, tracking the skimmer like a guided camera drone, then whip the orbit lower into a fast diagonal chase skimming above wavelets and broken masonry edges. Slingshot ahead for a brief head-on shot as the skimmer screams toward camera, pressure rippling the canal into V-shaped shock waves, then whip around into a close side chase where the hull slices the rain and spray detonates in clean sheets. Dive even tighter to the rear jet nozzles: droplets hammer into beads, debris taps and tumbles, mist boils into a tunnel, and the orbit compresses into a near-skimmer spiral, fast and relentless.A floating market raft cluster drifts far in the distance; sudden decision: the pilot cuts off-line through a narrow gap between two submerged archways, a sharp lateral slide with a burst of thrust, then snaps back into the canal with a precise, aggressive correction. The camera spears through the spray tunnel in the skimmer’s wake, then rockets upward into the final, fastest orbit: climb hard and spiral out to an epic reveal as the storm tears open and a towering sun shaft drops onto the flooded city like a spotlight, the skimmer a teal dart below with steam squalls and wake curls shimmering in the light.

【Shot-by-shot script】  
[00:00-00:05] Shot 1: The North · Trial by Fire  
Camera: Aerial overhead shot above Winterfell.  
Scene: Amid raging snowstorm, the massive black dragon Drogon descends like a dark cloud, diving straight toward Winterfell's courtyard.  
Action: Jon Snow stands in the center of the snowfield looking up, eyes filled with terror. Drogon opens his massive jaws and unleashes devastating red dragonfire, the entire screen instantly swallowed by violent flames (Screen Filled with Fire), symbolizing the final end of the betrayer.  

[00:05-00:10] Shot 2: King's Landing · Above the Ruins  
Camera: Low angle upward shot (Low Angle).  
Scene: The shattered Red Keep hall, ashes falling like snowflakes.  
Action: Daenerys steps over the rubble, her cloak dragging across the ground, walking with firm determination toward the supreme seat. Her back view appears lonely yet utterly invincible.  

[00:10-00:15] Shot 3: Finale · The True Dragon Ascends the Throne  
Camera: Direct frontal close-up with slow dolly in (Dolly In).  
Scene: Daenerys slowly turns around and sits steadily upon the Iron Throne.  
Action: She runs her hands over the jagged sword armrests, staring coldly straight into the camera (breaking the fourth wall).  
Effects: The gigantic black dragon Drogon emerges through the broken hole behind the throne, letting out an earth-shaking roar that proclaims the queen's absolute dominion.

1. 丹妮莉丝：银色辫发，身穿黑色坦格利安战斗盔甲，凶猛复仇的眼神。
2. 卓耿：巨大的黑红巨龙，体型更加庞大且凶猛。
3. 琼恩·雪诺：背后微小剪影，身穿北境皮毛斗篷，显得无助。

【分镜脚本】
[00:00-00:05] 镜头一：北境·火的试炼
镜头：临冬城上空的俯拍镜头。
场景：在狂暴的暴风雪中，巨大的黑龙卓耿像乌云一样降临，径直俯冲向临冬城的庭院。

镜头：低角度仰拍。
场景：破碎的红堡大厅，灰烬如雪花般飘落。
动作：丹妮莉丝跨过瓦砾，斗篷拖在地上，坚定地走向至高无上的王座。她的背影显得孤独却战无不胜。

[00:10-00:15] 镜头三：终局·真龙登基
镜头：正面特写配合缓慢推镜。
场景：丹妮莉丝缓缓转身，稳稳地坐在铁王座上。
动作：她抚摸着锯齿状的剑柄扶手，冷冷地直视镜头（打破第四面墙）。
特效：巨大的黑龙卓耿从王座后方的破洞中浮现，发出震耳欲聋的咆哮，宣告女王的绝对统治权。

英文提示词:
A multi-shot cinematic kitchen comedy about a family of mythical creatures. Integrated sound. Photorealistic, raw, cavernous tone, expressive micro-acting. No on-screen text. Photorealistic shooting. 180° shutter, 24 fps. Shot 1: Close-up of the little goblin girl at the wooden kitchen table (meets the reference). She is deadly serious, arms crossed, looking at her troll father, who is standing off-screen. She asks in clear, casual English, “Daddy, how do goblins come to be? Tell me.” Camera: Slow, subtle arc around her face (right to left), gently zooming in, shallow depth of field. Sound: Quiet kitchen tones, barely audible table creaks. Shot 2: Medium shot of her father opposite her. He freezes, looking around nervously, trying to deflect the topic. He says, “Uh… do you want some worms?” Camera: Handheld, arcing around him (left to right), ending in a slightly closer shot, as if the camera is “zooming in” on his panic. Sound: Wooden box creaking, his awkward voice. Shot 3: Medium close-up of the girl. She doesn’t blink, leans forward slightly. She says, “Daddy. Don’t change the subject.” Camera: Smooth zoom in with a slight pan to keep her centered in the frame, steady and confident. Sound: Her firm voice, the silence in the kitchen. Shot 4: Medium shot of the father. He reaches for the wooden plate of worms like a life preserver, putting on an amused expression. Camera: Quick pan to the plate of worms as he grabs it with his hand, then a controlled zoom back up to his face. Sound: Wood scraping against wood, worms crawling, flying mice in a cave. Shot 5: Over-the-shoulder shot from the goblin girl to the troll father, worms on a plate in abundance in the foreground. He advertises it a bit too insistently, smiling. He says, “These worms are so delicious. When you’re older, you’ll understand. Eat.” Camera: Slow arc around the worms on the plate in the foreground (heroic move), while the troll father remains in frame, with a subtle change of focus from the father to the plate of worms in the middle. Sound: Light chewing sound. Shot 6: Close-up of the goblin girl. She puffs out her cheeks, unimpressed, then mutters, “Oof… you did it again.” Camera: Tiny counter-rotation for a punchline, then a gentle pull back to release the tension. Sound: Her quiet sigh/snort, trolls and goblins movie vibe. Negative prompt: Dramatic crying, prolonged screams, terrifying tone, violence, text overlays, subtitles, logos.

Action: The creator's bare hands (slender and clean fingers) pick a bright red tomato with crystal dewdrops from the vine. 现代田园博主(Modern Creator)，黑色长发随意用一根木簪挽起，身穿深蓝色的舒适棉麻套装(Modern Linen Outfit)，妆容清透，眼神专注宁静。

【分镜详解】
[00:00-00:05] 镜头1：清晨采摘(The Freshness)

【Character (Live-Action Description)】 The Magma Admiral: Wearing a charred dark red suit, wearing a baseball cap, with a cold and resolute face, half of his body elementalized into scorching magma. The Ice General: Wearing a frosted white vest, tall and lazy, the exhaled breath turns into ice crystals.
[00:00-00:05] Shot 1: Element Awakening and Environment Reshaping. Wide/Aerial shot. The two confront each other. 【Magma Side】The ground under the Magma Admiral instantly melts into a boiling red magma pool, emitting rolling black smoke; as he raises his hand, a small volcano erupts behind him. 【Ice Side】The Ice General puts one hand in his pocket, and extremely fast freezing ice spreads instantly under his feet, freezing the surging magma into black obsidian, and the air is instantly filled with sharp ice spikes.
[00:05-00:10] Shot 2: Ice and Fire Close-Quarter Combat. Rapid Action Cuts. The two engage in fierce close-quarters combat. 【Action Design】A huge Ice Saber instantly condenses in the Ice General's hand and swings at high speed. The Magma Admiral uses his elementalized Magma Fist to block hard. 【Physical Feedback】The ice blade strikes the magma fist, instantly vaporizing into a large amount of high-pressure steam, accompanied by shattering ice and the sizzling sound of dripping magma. Every collision triggers a small-scale steam explosion.
[00:10-00:15] Shot 3: The Fatal Ultimate Clash. Extreme Long Shot/Shocking Destruction. The two distance themselves and release their ultimate moves simultaneously. 【VFX Spectacle】A giant, roaring Magma Hellhound (Magma Beast form) rushes towards the opponent; opposite is a giant Extreme Cold Ice Bird (Blizzard form) composed of countless ice blocks crashing head-on. 【Ending】The two collide in the center of the frame, the red extreme high temperature clashing with the blue-white absolute zero. Instantly, a super steam mushroom cloud connecting heaven and earth is produced, and a huge shockwave shatters the ground glaciers and volcanoes simultaneously. The screen ends amidst white steam and energy flashes.

cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
[Style] Viral Sketch Comedy, Portrait, Life-like camera movement, Exaggerated actor expressions, Clear sound effect beats.
[Duration] 15 seconds
[Characters]
Boss (Wearing a suit, carrying a briefcase, looking superior).
Employee Xiao Wang (Wearing casual clothes, looking honest and simple).
[Props] A top-tier luxury car (Ferrari/Rolls-Royce), A bucket and a rag.

[00:00-00:05] Shot 1: The Mockery.
Scene: Downstairs of the company. Xiao Wang is leaning against a brand new multi-million dollar luxury car smoking (or drinking water).
Action: The boss passes by, stops to pat Xiao Wang on the shoulder, looking preachy.
[Dialogue/Lip sync] Boss: "Xiao Wang, don't just stare blankly at the car. Work hard with me, maybe in the next life... you might be able to touch this wheel."

[00:05-00:10] Shot 2: The Shock.
Action: Xiao Wang smiles awkwardly, suddenly takes out a car key from his pocket.
Sound effect: "Beep!" (Car unlocking sound). The luxury car's lights flash, the trunk slowly pops open automatically.
Expression: The boss's chin drops in shock (Close-up), the briefcase almost falls to the ground. The boss instantly switches to a fawning expression, preparing to shake hands.
[Dialogue/Lip sync] Boss (Stuttering): "Oh my! Mr... Mr. Wang? So you are experiencing life!"

[00:10-00:15] Shot 3: The Punchline.
Action: Xiao Wang calmly takes out of the trunk... **a bucket and a dirty rag**.
Expression: Xiao Wang looks helpless, the boss's smile freezes on his face, instantly petrified.
[Dialogue/Lip sync] Xiao Wang: "Boss, please move aside, the owner is coming soon. I just took this car wash order, I have to rush to the next one."
(The screen freezes on the boss's embarrassed face, accompanied by the funny sound effect "Wasted" or "Gaga").

【风格】抖音搞笑段子（Viral Sketch Comedy），竖屏（Portrait），生活化运镜，演员表情夸张，音效卡点清晰。
【时长】15秒
【角色】
老板（穿西装，夹公文包，一脸优越感）。

【对白/口型】老板：“小王啊，别光看车发呆。好好跟着我干，下辈子……你兴许能摸一下这车轱辘。”

[00:05-00:10] 镜头2：第一次反转（The Shock）。
